mintAuthority.headline: Issuer minting is permissioned, while the deployed control inventory and upgrade execution paths remain incompletely verified.
mintAuthority.summary: The issuer lists a Minter on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base and Plume; every token deployment admits that Minter with unlimited current and maximum mint allowance. All four token proxies report version 5.0.0, have separately pinned implementation bytecode and share an access-control dispatcher. Pinned reads identify a live EOA with administrator and upgrader roles. The public repository describes an older token version and does not verify the deployed supply, rate, role or diamond-facet inventory. This is a partial control review, with the known issuer and upgrade powers preserved.

sources.label: Dinari current USD+ deployments and issuer minters

controls.label: Ethereum issuer Minter

sources.label: Dinari current USD+ deployments and issuer minters

controls.evidence: At block 26423677 / 0x0be0d3d678f2330427384c14b4bbfd8e180c91b9cc0097857d81e15ecdf3d158 (2026-11-15T23:24:35.000Z), mintingMaxLimitOf and mintingCurrentLimitOf for the issuer-listed Minter both returned uint256 maximum. This positively establishes an enabled issuer mint route on this deployment, not an immutable issuance ceiling or a complete census of other minters. The deployed publicVersion is 5.0.0; public repository version 1.0.0 does not establish current Minter execution, controller or payment parity.

controls.label: Ethereum issuer role administrator
controls.evidence: At block 26423677 / 0x0be0d3d678f2330427384c14b4bbfd8e180c91b9cc0097857d81e15ecdf3d158 (2026-11-15T23:24:35.000Z), the token accessControl getter names 0xf60f689ec22fc2d485b3c734efe58538ccc28766. Its userRoles getter returns 17 for this address, hasRole(address,0) returns true, and canCall(address,setUserRole(address,uint8,bool)) returns true. eth_getCode returns empty bytecode for this current administrator. These are affirmative current role-administration and EOA observations; the current complete supply-writer, permission, facet and controller census remains unverified.

controls.label: Ethereum issuer token upgrader

sources.label: Dinari current USD+ deployments and issuer minters

controls.evidence: The pinned token implementation slot and runtime are retained at block 26423677 / 0x0be0d3d678f2330427384c14b4bbfd8e180c91b9cc0097857d81e15ecdf3d158 (2026-11-15T23:24:35.000Z). The current UUPS upgrade path calls the shared access controller with hasRole(caller,4); the observed administrator bitmap 17 includes role four and its account has no bytecode. The authority is retained even though a complete deployed-source, alternative-upgrader and execution-delay inventory has not been verified.

review.evidence: Fresh fixed-block RPC reads verify every token identity, decimals, supply, implementation, shared access controller, active issuer allowance and named administrator. Ethereum selector-to-facet storage and the facets() loupe positively identify the current access dispatcher and role surface. Explorer and Sourcify reads did not retrieve current implementation source. Reverting old-version ABI calls are retained as failed reads, not absence of a controller or Safe. The observed EOA root is a known adverse control fact; it does not establish a complete execution or issuer assurance review.
unresolvedQuestions: What is the complete deployed version-five inventory of native mint, supply-index/rate, issuer-limit, role-administration, upgrade and diamond-facet powers, their current controllers and execution bypasses?
Does current independent reserve-to-liability reconciliation cover every native USD+ claim, and what supervision applies to the exact issuing activity?
